audience.programmeDescription: The University of Amsterdam’s French Language and Culture bachelor combines French proficiency with linguistics, literature, film and study of French-speaking societies. It includes a study-abroad semester and a research project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers European history, literary and film analysis, and general linguistics. Amsterdam’s degree develops sustained study of French and Francophone literature, society and language. The table shows the full Amsterdam curriculum.

componentNotes.fra-124221008y: The standard second-year route includes a semester at a French-speaking university. Students need at least 54 first-year EC and must have attended the first semester of year two. The Board of Examiners may approve a 30 EC substitute for valid reasons.
componentNotes.fra-approved-free-profiling-space: Choose 30 EC of eligible electives. A minor or approved internship can count.
componentNotes.fra-124229012y: The project draws on prior French studies and requires enough written French to report the research in French.

linkChecks.officialProgramme: Inspected the umbrella degree and both track pages
linkChecks.regulations: Read Arts regulations Parts A and B and the programme annex
linkChecks.assessment: Inspected dated programme and course records for French proficiency, study abroad, linguistics, cinema and the research project

mapping.explanation and status: The no-match status follows the exception type. render_audience_context selects the programme description and academic explanation.
